name: PaletteShare
author: Annerose
description: See your opponent's custom palettes online, and they see yours. Pick your own palettes at character select (.pal, .act or .bmp files in modules\PaletteShare\palettes), each with a fallback slot that players without PaletteShare see. Also shares palettes from shady-loader packages, edited data files and palette-picker. Ctrl+P toggles the opponent's custom palette mid-match. See the README and PaletteShare.ini.
